UserSettings.title: UserSettings
UserSettings.description: Private preferences and active tasbih configuration for an authenticated user.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: User display name shown in the profile pill and synced to leaderboard.

soundEnabled.description: Whether subtle tactile bead click sound is enabled.

vibrateEnabled.description: Whether haptic vibration on each tasbih tap is enabled.

activeDhikrId.description: Identifier of the currently selected dhikr.

targetCount.description: Current session target count (0 means unlimited/open).

updatedAt.description: Last update server timestamp (written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

CustomDhikr.title: CustomDhikr
CustomDhikr.description: A user-authored custom dhikr entry stored under the owner's private subcollection.

title.description: Arabic or custom dhikr phrase text.

target.description: Preferred default target count for this dhikr (0 means open).

countsAsIstighfar.description: Whether taps on this dhikr also contribute to daily/all-time Istighfar metrics.

updatedAt.description: Last update server timestamp (written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: Non-PII public tasbih stats and live competition scoreboard record for an authenticated user.

userId.description: Authenticated user UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: Public nickname displayed on the leaderboard (no email or PII).

visibility.description: Explicit public visibility flag checked by allow list rules and client queries.

todayDate.description: UTC/local calendar date key (YYYY-MM-DD) for daily counter reset.

todayTotal.description: Total tasbih count accumulated on todayDate.

todayIstighfar.description: Total istighfar count accumulated on todayDate.

dhikrTotals.description: Map of dhikrId to cumulative all-time count (max 40 entries).

dhikrToday.description: Map of dhikrId to today's count (max 40 entries).

updatedAt.description: Last update server timestamp (written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-only user settings and active tasbih configuration.

/users/{userId}/custom_adhkar/{dhikrId}.description: Owner-only custom adhkar created by the user.

/leaderboard/{userId}.description: Public competition and global community statistics records (zero PII, owner-write, authenticated-read with visibility == 'public').
